note: Corrections to overlay-locations.json, applied when the table is read. A pack can register its art in the wrong RaceMenu list and the table records what the pack said, not what it meant. Each fixup names a registration script by its file name (the tail of a by_source key in the table; case does not matter) and says which overlay locations that script's warpaint-only registrations really belong on: body, hands, feet, face, or a comma list of them. A fixup only adds locations to rows no pack placed anywhere; it never takes one away and never touches a texture a pack did place. The warpaint bit stays, so a corrected texture is still offered under Makeup as well. If this file is missing or will not parse, nothing is corrected and the log line says so.

fixups.why: Shep's Female Tattoo Collection registers all 132 of its body tattoos with AddWarpaint, so RaceMenu offers them only under war paint. They are body art and belong on the body page.
Sheps Male Tattoo Collection does the same with its 132: AddWarpaint for body art. Body page.
